Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy to molecule_dictionary on parent_molregno to include parent and salts. Join compound_structures on molregno. Join compound_records on molregno. Join activities on record_id. Join docs on doc_id. Join assays on assay_id. Join target_dictionary on tid. Filter molecule_dictionary chembl_id to CHEMBL1173655 or parent_molregno mapped from CHEMBL1173655. Filter activities standard_type to IC50. Filter activities standard_units to nM. Filter target_dictionary chembl_id to CHEMBL203. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
